mapper.select: select message_id, conversation_id, turn_id, role, content, answered, refusal_reason, model_name, trace_id, agent_payload, feedback_type, feedback_comment, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from oc_ai_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by message_id

select recent.message_id, recent.conversation_id, recent.turn_id, recent.role, recent.content, recent.answered, recent.refusal_reason, recent.model_name, recent.trace_id, recent.agent_payload, recent.feedback_type, recent.feedback_comment, recent.create_by, recent.create_time, recent.update_by, recent.update_time from ( select message_id, conversation_id, turn_id, role, content, answered, refusal_reason, model_name, trace_id, agent_payload, feedback_type, feedback_comment, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from oc_ai_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by message_id desc limit #{limit} ) recent order by recent.message_id

select message_id, conversation_id, turn_id, role, content, answered, refusal_reason, model_name, trace_id, agent_payload, feedback_type, feedback_comment, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from oc_ai_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and turn_id = #{turnId} order by message_id
mapper.insert: insert into oc_ai_message ( conversation_id, turn_id, role, content, answered, refusal_reason, model_name, trace_id, agent_payload, feedback_type, feedback_comment, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{conversationId}, #{turnId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{answered}, #{refusalReason}, #{modelName}, #{traceId}, #{agentPayload}, #{feedbackType}, #{feedbackComment}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update oc_ai_message msg inner join oc_ai_conversation conv on conv.conversation_id = msg.conversation_id set msg.feedback_type = #{feedbackType}, msg.feedback_comment = #{feedbackComment}, msg.update_by = #{updateBy}, msg.update_time = sysdate() where msg.message_id = #{messageId} and msg.role = 'assistant' and conv.user_id = #{userId} and conv.status = '0' and conv.del_flag = '0'
